records.name: Maluku
records.summary:
Both audited sources for Maluku are national and were only partly retrievable: a 2022 wire report on police denying mistreatment in the death in Bali custody of a transgender activist arrested on drug charges (page not retrievable; fetch-time summary), and an August 2026 feature on widening repression of Indonesia's transgender community, including vigilante mob attacks (navigation-only at fetch; headline and dossier summary).

Neither source documents any Maluku-specific enforcement, ordinance, protection or service. The province is assessed on the national picture those sources sketch: criminalisation of same-sex conduct concentrated in the one province retaining religious courts, gender recognition restricted by surgery-plus-court rules, and an official and street-level hostility climate hardening since 2016 - asserted here only at the confidence the two hedged summaries support.
